title: DCP Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the OpenCode Dynamic Context Pruning plugin

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocomplete

enabled.description: Enable or disable the DCP plugin

autoUpdate.description: Automatically update npm-installed DCP when a newer npm latest version is available. Version-locked plugin specs are not updated.

pruneNotification.description: Level of notification shown when context management occurs

pruneNotificationType.description: Where to display notifications (chat message or toast notification)

protectedTools.description: Additional tool names or wildcard patterns to protect from pruning via commands (e.g., /dcp sweep). Supports glob wildcards: * matches any characters, ? matches a single character (e.g., "mcp_*", "my_tool_?")

manualMode.description: Manual mode behavior for context management tools

enabled.description: Start new sessions with manual mode enabled

automaticStrategies.description: When manual mode is enabled, keep automatic deduplication/purge strategies running

turnProtection.description: Protect recent tool outputs from being pruned

turns.description: Number of recent turns to protect from pruning

experimental.description: Experimental settings that may change in future releases

allowSubAgents.description: Allow DCP processing in subagent sessions

customPrompts.description: Enable user-editable prompt overrides under dcp-prompts directories

protectedFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files that should be protected from pruning (e.g., '**/*.config.ts')

compress.description: Configuration for the unified compress tool

mode.description: Compression mode. 'range' compresses spans into block summaries, 'message' compresses individual raw messages.

summaryBuffer.description: When enabled, active summary tokens extend the effective maxContextLimit used for context-limit nudges.

maxContextLimit.description: Soft upper threshold. Above this, DCP keeps sending strong compression nudges (based on nudgeFrequency), so the model is pushed to compress. Accepts number or "X%" of the model context window.

minContextLimit.description: Soft lower threshold for reminder nudges. Below this, turn/iteration reminders are off (compression is less likely). At or above this, reminders are on. Accepts number or "X%" of the model context window.

modelMaxLimits.description: Per-model override for maxContextLimit by exact provider/model key. If set, this takes priority over the global maxContextLimit.

modelMinLimits.description: Per-model override for minContextLimit by exact provider/model key. If set, this takes priority over the global minContextLimit.

nudgeFrequency.description: How often the context-limit nudge fires when above maxContextLimit (1 = every fetch, 5 = every 5th fetch)

iterationNudgeThreshold.description: How many messages to wait after a user message before adding compression reminders.

nudgeForce.description: Controls how likely compression is after user messages. 'strong' is more likely, 'soft' is less likely.

protectedTools.description: Tool names or wildcard patterns whose completed outputs should be appended to the compression summary. Supports glob wildcards: * matches any characters, ? matches a single character (e.g., "mcp_*", "my_tool_?")

protectTags.description: Preserve text wrapped in <protect>...</protect> when compressed

protectUserMessages.description: When enabled, your messages are never lost during compression

summaryStyle.description: Writing style for compression summaries. 'detailed' keeps prose explanation; 'terse' writes dense telegraphic/caveman-style summaries; 'wenyan' writes Classical Chinese (文言文) summaries with 80-90% character reduction. All styles preserve full technical substance.

preSweep.description: Run a sweep/prune pass before model-triggered compression

enabled.description: Prune stale tool outputs before every automatic compress execution

count.description: Number of most recent tool calls to prune before compressing (0 sweeps all tools since the previous user message)

protectedTools.description: Tool names or wildcard patterns excluded from deduplication. Supports glob wildcards: * matches any characters, ? matches a single character (e.g., "mcp_*", "my_tool_?")

purgeErrors.description: Remove tool outputs that resulted in errors

turns.description: Number of turns after which errors are purged

protectedTools.description: Tool names or wildcard patterns excluded from error purging. Supports glob wildcards: * matches any characters, ? matches a single character (e.g., "mcp_*", "my_tool_?")

purgeReasoning.description: Strip reasoning (thinking) parts from old assistant messages using hysteresis. Reasoning is scratch work - after the final result is produced the verbose chains carry no information, but they are counted against the context budget. Reasoning accumulates freely until it exceeds 'highWater' parts, then the oldest messages' reasoning is stripped down to 'lowWater' parts. Batching pruning into bursts is cache-friendlier for providers that dislike mid-stream reasoning mutation. Runs in the request transform on every turn, independent of compression. OFF by default - providers with caching semantics may penalize reasoning pruning.

turns.description: Minimum turn age before a message's reasoning is eligible for stripping

highWater.description: Prune once total reasoning parts in the request exceed this count. Conservative default (60) leaves headroom - reasoning stays intact longer; lower manually for more aggressive pruning

lowWater.description: Prune down to this many reasoning parts (must be less than highWater). Conservative default (20) retains more reasoning after a prune burst; lower manually for more aggressive stripping

protectedTools.description: Tool names or wildcard patterns. Messages that called one of these tools keep their reasoning. Supports glob wildcards

pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run VCC.py

exportDir.description: Output directory for VCC exports (defaults to dcp storage vcc/ subdirectory)

autoExport.description: Automatically export + compile VCC views when a compression completes

tokenTruncation.description: Token truncation limit for assistant content in brief view

userTokenLimit.description: Token truncation limit for user content in brief view

postMode.description: What to post to chat after auto compile: 'fullminview' posts the brief view, 'notice' posts a short pointer to the view files, 'off' compiles silently

rotateKeep.description: Number of previous view files to keep as gzipped archives (.txt.1.gz, .txt.2.gz, ...). Old archives beyond this count are removed. Set to 0 to disable rotation.

maxReturnChars.description: Maximum characters of VCC grep/search output returned to the model. A technical safeguard against context bloat - policy is setup-specific (local vs provider tiered context, long-context models). Raise cautiously; this truncates the search result text only, full views remain on disk.

semantic.description: Semantic search over VCC exports via the vcc-semantic.py sidecar. When enabled, view(query) tries semantic search first and falls back to BM25 on failure.

enabled.description: Prefer semantic search over BM25 for view(query) calls

provider.description: Embedding provider: 'api' (HTTP embeddings endpoint) or 'onnx' (local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via onnxruntime)

apiKey.description: Bearer token for the embeddings API (optional)

model.description: API model id (provider=api) or path to model.onnx (provider=onnx)

scriptPath.description: Absolute path to vcc-semantic.py (defaults to scripts dir next to VCC.py)
